name: Riftglass Dragon - Adult
description: Adult Riftglass is a evil-leaning eclipsed intelligent true dragon with fractured violet crystal plates reflecting unreal lives. It seeks to turn certainty into contradiction. At this age it is a commanding force in its territory.

attacks.name: Crystal Claws
attacks.description: The dragon strikes one target within Very Close range with its primary natural weapons.

abilities.name: Relentless (3)
abilities.description: The dragon can be spotlighted up to 3 times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

abilities.name: False Reflection
abilities.description: The first attack against the dragon each GM turn has disadvantage.

abilities.name: Refraction Breath
abilities.description: Spend a Fear to exhale a cone reaching Close range. All enemies in the cone make an Agility Reaction Roll against Difficulty 19. On a failure, take 3d8+6 magic damage and the dragon moves the target to another visible place within Very Close range. On a success, take half damage without the additional effect.

abilities.name: Contradictory Paths
abilities.description: Mark a Stress. Choose up to two creatures within Close range. Each must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or be moved to an unoccupied visible place within Close range and become Vulnerable until its next action.

abilities.name: One More Reflection
abilities.description: Once per scene, when an attack would make the dragon mark its last HP, mark 1 Stress instead, move it to an unoccupied visible place within Close range, and leave 1 HP unmarked.

abilities.name: Roused Fury
abilities.description: Once per scene, immediately after the dragon marks half its total HP (round up), clear 1 Stress and move up to Close range. This movement does not grant an attack.
